source: pass 2: the write-only credentials of ConfigurationDTO (a @JsonIgnore getter and a @JsonProperty setter routed through ConfigurationProperties.restoreRedactedValue): never disclosed by GET /mockserver/configuration, settable by PUT, and a mask-carrying value leaves the held credential untouched. Also ConfigurationDTOTest.shouldRoundTripDashboardAnalyticsThroughJson and shouldRoundTripLoadGenerationMetricLabelsThroughJson. isolated because it PUTs configuration (data-plane and proxy authentication) that reset does not clear.

steps.note: an expectation the data-plane probes reach once authenticated
set every write-only credential plus the dashboard analytics fields and loadGenerationMetricLabels: the answer names none of the credentials, the analytics key and the labels round-trip in clear
proxy authentication needs the username too: with it, the PUT password takes effect
a proxied request without Proxy-Authorization is refused with 407
every write-only credential sent back as the mask, or carrying it: each is left as it was; forwardProxyPrivateKey's mask is refused before its file check, so the PUT is not rejected
the mask was not stored as the proxy password: a credential carrying it is still refused
turn proxy authentication off again and require data-plane authentication with Basic and API-key credentials (passwords set above)
the PUT Basic password survived the masked PUT: reaches the expectation
the mask is not the Basic password
the PUT API key survived the mask-carrying PUT
the mask-carrying value is not the API key
capture the configuration to echo straight back
GET-then-PUT round trip of the whole body, which names none of the write-only credentials
the Basic password survives the round trip
a real new Basic password replaces the old one
the old password no longer passes
